page.overview:
Who is Ailill Nuada?

Ailill Nuada is an Aeldari Harlequin Shadowseer. During the final years of the 41st Millennium, she represented the Harlequins in the Conclave of Tears, while also acting as the Conclave's figurehead.

As a member of the enigmatic Aeldari caste known as the Harlequins, Ailill Nuada is a riddle even to her fellow members of the Conclave of Tears. The Harlequins are uniquely placed within Aeldari society, for they rise above any stresses that might exist between the different factions.

Where the Asuryani of the craftworlds might be loath to seek the aid of the Drukhari in Commorragh, for example, the Harlequins treat both exactly the same.

Outsiders often make the mistake of assuming this is a matter of good and evil, with the people of the craftworlds somehow representing a morally pure side of the Aeldari psyche, and the Aeldari of the Dark City representing the polar opposite.
